name: com.thaiprops/mcp
title: ThaiProps Thailand Real Estate
description: Search live published Thailand properties and projects from ThaiProps.

tools.name: thaiprops_search_properties
tools.description:
Search live published ThaiProps listings across Thailand using natural language.

    Use this for requests such as "pet friendly 2 bedroom condo near Ekkamai BTS
    under 55,000 baht", "house for sale in Phuket with pool", or other Thailand
    property requirements. ThaiProps AI Search interprets the request and the
    returned properties include canonical ThaiProps URLs for citation and viewing.
    Return up to 50 matching properties by default. Do not arbitrarily collapse the
    returned tool results to a top-3 or top-10 shortlist. Unless the user explicitly
    asks for a shorter shortlist, present all returned matching properties. If
    total_results is larger than the returned set, preserve the ThaiProps view_all_url.

    Args:
        query: The user's original natural-language property requirement.
        mode: Optional buy or rent hint.
        province: Optional Thailand province hint such as Bangkok, Phuket or Chiang Mai.
        limit: Number of property results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 50.

query.description: Natural-language Thailand property requirements, e.g. 'pet-friendly 2-bedroom condo near BTS Ekkamai under 55000 THB' or 'pool villa for sale in Phuket'.
query.title: Query

mode.description: Optional transaction type: 'rent' for rental listings or 'buy' for properties for sale; omit to infer from query.
mode.title: Mode

province.description: Optional Thai province filter such as Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai or Chon Buri; omit for nationwide search.
province.title: Province

limit.description: Maximum number of property matches to return, 1 to 50; default 50. Preserve view_all_url if more results exist.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: thaiprops_get_property
tools.description: Get public details for one published ThaiProps property by numeric property ID.

property_id.description: Numeric ThaiProps property ID from property search results or a ThaiProps property URL; returns public listing details only.
property_id.title: Property Id

tools.name: thaiprops_get_project
tools.description: Get public details for one published ThaiProps real-estate project by numeric project ID.

project_id.description: Numeric ThaiProps project ID from project search results or a ThaiProps project URL; returns public project details only.
project_id.title: Project Id

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Standard read-only search tool for AI hosts that expect search/fetch semantics.

    Searches live ThaiProps Thailand property inventory and returns concise,
    citable result records with IDs and absolute URLs.

query.description: Natural-language Thailand property search, including area or landmark, transaction type, budget, bedrooms and facilities.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Maximum number of citable search results, 1 to 50; default 50.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Standard read-only fetch tool.

    Accepts IDs returned by search, such as property:713266 or project:964576.
    A plain numeric ID is treated as a ThaiProps property ID.

id.description: Identifier returned by search, e.g. 'property:713266' or 'project:964576'; a plain numeric ID is treated as a property ID.
id.title: Id
